name: hub-sealed-home
goal: Prove ciphertext-only scoped storage, cached transcript before network, delta and live delivery with a verified browser enrollment, and browser latency budget

steps.title: Confirm scope, success criteria, constraints, and proof.
steps.evidence: Approved design #310; compare existing Home and an enrolled browser with the same synthetic workload, verify offline first text, then delta and authenticated live output. Existing Home has no transcript action.

steps.title: Implement the smallest complete feature slice.
steps.evidence: 425450816e implements account-partitioned ciphertext and cursor transactions, local keys checked against the signed chain, cache-first Home, and authenticated delta/live reception. Device approval, browser live upgrade and attached Mac publisher require the separately owned rollout work.

steps.title: Add or update focused automated coverage.
steps.evidence: The publisher-linked fixture failed on 422be9d0c7 at the missing persisted chunk assertion.
